_comment: Hand-maintained patches merged into schema.json by generate-schema.js. Use only for values the static parser cannot resolve (enum-derived choices and defaults, descriptions missing upstream, source-expression defaultText made human-readable). Keep entries minimal and verify against neonctl source when refreshing the schema pin.

help.describe: Show help for a command or subcommand

api-key.describe: Neon API key, authenticates without `neon login`

config-dir._comment: Default resolved at runtime by configDir() in _shared/paths.ts; verified at neonctl 8.3.4. The directory was ~/.config/neonctl before the rename; an existing one is still read but never written.

context-file.describe: Context file with default org, project, and branch IDs, created by `neon link`
context-file.defaultText: nearest .neon file, searching upward from the current directory

services._comment: Built by the servicesOption() factory in neon_services.ts, which the static parser can't evaluate (factory call as an option-spec value, in a non-command file; the describe is composed from an array join). See generate-schema.js parseOptionSpec for the limitation. type, alias, and describe verified against config.ts and neon_services.ts at neonctl 8.3.4, which replaced `none` with `postgres` for the starter policy.
services.describe: Services the scaffolded neon.ts declares: postgres, auth, data-api, functions, object-storage, ai-gateway. Repeat the flag or comma-separate. postgres alone writes the starter policy; every branch has Postgres. Omitted: pick interactively on a terminal, starter policy in CI or without a TTY.

service._comment: Built by the servicesOption() factory in neon_services.ts (see config init services override). type, alias, and describe verified against env.ts (ENV_PULL_SERVICES = NEON_SERVICES) at neonctl 8.3.4.
service.describe: Pull only these services' variables: postgres, auth, data-api, functions, object-storage, ai-gateway. Repeat the flag or comma-separate. Overrides neon.ts, and prunes only within the services you name. Combines with --env as a union.

env-pull.describe: Pull the branch's Neon env vars (DATABASE_URL, ...) into a local .env after checkout. On by default; use --no-env-pull to skip, for example when injecting env at runtime with `neon-env run` (from `@neon/env`) or `neon dev`.

profile._comment: Limit the table to the two common create paths (browser sign-in, then --mint). The upstream `.example()` list also demonstrates storing a pre-existing key via --api-key; that rarer path and its stdin/argument trade-off are covered in prose on the page instead. Same commands and descriptions as source (profile.ts) for the examples kept.

examples.description: Sign in with the browser, like `neon login --profile work`
One browser sign-in, then an org-scoped key and no session left behind

env-pull.describe: Pull the linked branch's Neon env vars (DATABASE_URL, ...) into a local .env after linking. On by default; use --no-env-pull to skip, for example when injecting env at runtime with `neon-env run` (from `@neon/env`) or `neon dev`.

hipaa.describe: Enable HIPAA compliance for the project.
Enable HIPAA compliance for the project.

provider-id.describe: OAuth provider ID. Supported values: google, github, vercel
OAuth provider ID. Supported values: google, github, vercel
OAuth provider ID. Supported values: google, github, vercel

frequency.describe: How often to take snapshots. Combine with --hour, --day, and --retention to build a single-entry schedule.

service._comment: Built by the servicesOption() factory in neon_services.ts (see config init services override). Passed as `.option("service", servicesOption(...))`, which the parser drops entirely, so this override supplies the whole option. Verified against claim.ts at neonctl 8.3.4.
service.describe: Services to request for the claimable project: postgres, auth, data-api, functions, object-storage, ai-gateway. Repeat the flag or comma-separate. Postgres is always included. Services unavailable before claim are recorded and reported.

services._comment: Built by the servicesOption() factory and passed as `.option("services", servicesOption(...))`, which the parser drops entirely, so this override supplies the whole option. Verified against init.ts and neon_services.ts at neonctl 8.3.4.
services.describe: Services to declare in neon.ts: postgres, auth, data-api, functions, object-storage, ai-gateway. Repeat the flag or comma-separate. postgres alone writes the starter policy; every branch has Postgres. Implies creating neon.ts. Cannot be combined with --no-config.
